TransactionSecurityPolicy.customEmailContent:
Salesforce Security Alert – SSO Bypass Login Detected


A browser-based login to Salesforce has been detected outside the approved SAML Single Sign-On authentication flow.


Policy: {{policy.MasterLabel}}

Organization ID: {{policy.OrganizationId}}

User: {{event.Username}}

Event Date: {{event.EventDate}}

Source IP: {{event.SourceIp}}

Application: {{event.Application}}

Login Type: {{event.LoginType}}

Login URL: {{event.LoginUrl}}


This activity may indicate a direct Salesforce login bypassing the corporate SSO authentication flow.


No login has been automatically blocked.


Please review the activity and confirm whether the authentication method is expected and authorized.


Salesforce Security Monitoring
TransactionSecurityPolicy.description: Detects browser-based Salesforce login activity that does not use an approved SAML Single Sign-On flow. The policy alerts the Security team when an interactive login bypasses corporate SSO authentication.
